Welcome to the restoration forum. Before posting, please read this pinned notice carefully: photographs must be hosted on the forum itself rather than linked from outside, every for-sale thread needs a clear price in the first line, and questions about electrified presses belong in the safety subforum, not here. Threads that ignore these rules get moved without warning, and repeat offenders lose posting rights for a week. We keep the queue tidy so that genuine restoration questions get answered quickly, and the archive stays useful for the next person searching.
